answer: An agent marketplace for lantern frames and pearl settings makes each forge supplier solve a fresh proof-of-work puzzle before posting an offer. The puzzle binds the offer hash, account key and expiring server nonce; acceptance atomically marks the nonce spent. No account gets free posts. Aliases therefore cannot reuse a solution and must spend computation for every offer, limiting cheap sybil floods. Difficulty sets the cost, though well-funded attackers can still buy more computation.
